en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a tree-lined street scene with people standing and walking, including children and adults. There is a bicycle in the foreground and several people are dressed in early 20th-century European clothing. The street is wide and appears to be unpaved. The buildings along the street are multi-storied and have a historic architectural style. The text on the card identifies the location and publisher.
